title: relabel
description: Routes matched events to another label without changing the record payload.

fields.name: @id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the plugin instance.

fields.name: @log_level
fields.description: Plugin-specific log level that overrides the global system log level.

fields.name: @label
fields.description: Target label receiving the matched events.

directive_argument.name: match
directive_argument.description: Tag pattern selecting events for this output.
